data_bindings.allowlist_scope: same original three Rule-B train patients,715 SOP; no expansion; only previously fixed slices

input_policy.input_domain: frozen prepared scalar CT before RGB normalization
input_policy.normalization: repeat scalar RGB then subtract [.485,.456,.406] divide [.229,.224,.225]
input_policy.support_policy: E2-CT: preserve outside valid_support; optimization differs from literal E2-REF over full image

algorithm.similarity: sum of squared differences of all logits
algorithm.cpf: max top1-top2 gap over entire feasible set; strict Ls<alpha and Lm<beta; no positive-gap rejection
algorithm.ties: earliest equal-gap feasible iteration; lowest flat index for equal maxima
algorithm.stage_baseline: fresh residual baseline each scale/stage; Omega used twice
algorithm.psmi: whole reference patch; any-stage intersection; max one vote per other scale

stopping.no_feasible_mask: NO_FEASIBLE_MASK for completed branch; skip later stages of that scale only; preserve actual denominators
stopping.no_support: NO_MULTISCALE_SUPPORT only after declared required branches/votes evaluated
stopping.budget_or_memory_or_monitor_failure: PARTIAL_BUDGET or FAILED monitor; best-so-far not full-plan optimum
stopping.residual_class_change: record; do not reinterpret all later patches as original disease
stopping.global_counter: durable reserve/entered/completed, includes audits, failed/inflight calls and every restart; no reset
stopping.shutdown: independent shared supervisor; only own newly-created processes; receipt plus exit/device recovery required

prerequisites: explicit per-profile human approval and chief config SHA confirmation
valid formal same-three development/data delivery; no sealed data
synthetic optimizer restoration and targeted shared-supervisor integration checks
prospective evaluator/candidate budget unchanged; independent GT evaluation after generation
selection: same prospective case_index1, at most one original case
scope: complete paper parameter values transferred to CT adapter; not original retinal performance reproduction
resume_policy: explicit1000-update segments; at most9 restorations per scale/stage; no automatic retries or unused-Wave1-quota reuse

cost.diagnostic_rule: two audit forwards for every restored1000-step segment,9 restores per branch; all audits charged; at most1 additional pending-observation forward per restoration, charged separately
